title: Abraham's Road: From Ur to Canaan
notes: Distances are straight-line (as the crow flies), not walking routes. Historicity flagged as debated in beat 12.

beats.text: How far did Abraham really travel?
Genesis eleven begins in Ur of the Chaldeans, in southern Mesopotamia.
beats.say: Genesis eleven begins in Ur of the Kal-DEE-ans, in southern Mess-oh-poh-TAY-mee-ah.

beats.text: Ur was real: its ziggurat still stands in Iraq.
beats.say: Ur was real: its ZIG-oo-rat still stands in Iraq.
beats.label: UR'S ZIGGURAT

beats.text: His father Terah leads the family north-west to Haran, in what is now Turkey.
beats.say: His father TEH-rah leads the family north-west to HAR-an, in what is now Turkey.

beats.text: Ur to Haran: about nine hundred kilometres as the crow flies.
beats.say: Ur to HAR-an: about nine hundred kilometres as the crow flies.

beats.text: In Haran, God tells Abram to go. He is seventy-five.
beats.say: In HAR-an, God tells AY-bram to go. He is seventy-five.

beats.text: He crosses to Shechem, in the hills of Canaan, and builds an altar.
beats.say: He crosses to SHEK-em, in the hills of Canaan, and builds an altar.

beats.text: To your offspring I will give this land.
beats.display: To your offspring I will give this land.

beats.text: Then Bethel, where he builds another altar, and on south into the Negev.
beats.say: Then BETH-el, where he builds another altar, and on south into the NEG-ev.

beats.text: Famine strikes, so he goes down to Egypt.
beats.label: FAMINE

beats.text: Genesis twelve lists camels among Pharaoh's gifts. Some scholars say domesticated camels came later.
What's not proven: Abraham himself. No record outside the Bible names him, and historicity is debated.
Ur to Egypt: one family's road across the Fertile Crescent.
Real journey, legend, or memory of both? What do you think?

youtube.description:
From Ur to Haran to Shechem to Egypt: Genesis 11-12 traced on the map. How much of the road would you trust?
Abraham's historicity is debated, and distances shown are straight-line.
